A01.summary: Shown: z_msgevent.c runs bytecode with a saved instruction position, handler/size tables, conditional branches, callback waits and text IDs. CheckTextChoice selects offsets for three choices; commands can change rupees, items, week flags and notebook events. Anju's 0x28BA onward exchange alternates actor focus, waits on text/callbacks, records both people, then marks the encounter heard. This is authored dialogue, not generated prose. Full localized prose and a portrait census are unread without extracted message assets.

yairpg.takeaway: Separate line ID, speaker, eligibility, wait and paid effect. Interrupting before settlement must not silently count a promise as fulfilled.

A02.summary: Shown: notebook_table.h has 20 person rows and 35 event rows. Person rows bind photo identifiers, text IDs and met flags; event rows bind icon, current-color flag, message IDs and recorded-history flag. Message_BombersNotebookProcessEventQueue deduplicates stored events, sets history even when presentation is gated, and displays a notebook message only when the notebook is owned. Narrative recollection and present quest fulfillment have separate flags.

yairpg.takeaway: Keep a recalled appointment visible while its current attempt is unfulfilled. Knowledge is not the present truth of the world.

A03.summary: Shown: native C actor overlays and shared PlayState. Play_UpdateMain calls actor, message, interface, camera and environment updates with pause/transition gates. Play_Update has a separate notebook-open path rather than running ordinary world updates behind it. Schedule and message event interpreters are separate from actor action functions. This is bounded architecture coverage; OS/audio/render scheduling is indexed but not semantically audited.

yairpg.takeaway: Keep timetable selection, conversation execution and public projection distinct. A UI read must not become a simulation tick.

A04.summary: Shown: Save/SaveContext memory is copied into flash buffers; save signatures and a checksum select valid main/backup data. The checked validation branch tries the backup after a bad primary, then clears its buffer if both fail. Song-of-Time reset masks scene/week flags through explicit persistence tables and resets selected clock, inventory and quest fields. Owl and cycle save paths differ. Not shown: a versioned migration scheme or offline catch-up. The whole save-field census remains partial.

yairpg.takeaway: Define reset retention by owned field and reset reason. Validate backups before recovery; preserve rejected bytes rather than copy the source's destructive fallback.

A05.summary: Shown: conditional schedule bytecode checks time, day, flags and scene, returning a result/time window. Anju maps that result to actor behavior and routes; the promise and pendant facts choose later presence. This is an authored routine selector. It does not demonstrate autonomous goals or a global off-screen relationship simulation.

yairpg.takeaway: A changed promise can change tonight's destination. Bind the visible schedule to observer evidence and recheck co-location on arrival.

A06.summary: Shown: the notebook maps people and events to photos, icons and current/history flags. Play_Update allows L/B/Start to close it and clears message state. The world-update path changes while it is open. Actual screen layout, readable type size, controller feel and accessibility were not exercised; no desktop remake UI is inferred from N64 data.

yairpg.takeaway: PROPOSAL at 1366x768 and 1920x1080: show people, observed windows and selected event detail beside one another. Mobile work is deferred.

A07.summary: Stated by repository docs: .schl was invented by the community for reading/modifying bytecode. Shown: actor schedule files, macro message scripts and notebook tables localize authoring by subsystem. The checkout's generated message_data.enc.h is referenced, not acquired as a full text catalogue. No official mod API or Nintendo content editor was established.

yairpg.takeaway: Validate message targets and schedule windows as authoring data. Do not confuse a reconstruction tool with the source studio's editor.

A08.summary: Shown: schedule ranges subtract one from the end before an inclusive comparison, giving an exclusive authored end. qrand.c uses a seeded 32-bit recurrence and constructs [0,1) floats from integer bits. Three-day reset count saturates at 999. No checked consumer establishes pity, saved RNG continuity or a full economy curve; those remain unread.

yairpg.takeaway: State interval semantics and RNG ownership explicitly. A displayed counter cap should not create a fixed solo-player attempt limit.

A09.summary: Shown: environment clock advance is conditional on pause, game-over, dialogue exceptions, transition, frame advance and cutscene state. Anju's route reads the shared phase, not a real-world timer. No offline simulation is established. Prior Double Time and slowdown details are retained as prior evidence, not newly expanded here.

yairpg.takeaway: A wait queue must stop at decisions and crossed causal boundaries. Never equate a paused interface with elapsed world time without a declared world rule.

A10.summary: Shown: notebook ownership gates the queued event text, while event-history recording is independent. Met flags govern person recognition; readable schedule knowledge is earned through encounters. The full introductory cycle, tutorial ordering and every mask reveal are unread.

yairpg.takeaway: Earned recognition may unlock a planning view without exposing all undiscovered people or their future routes.

A11.summary: Shown: focus-to-child/self commands keep a multi-person exchange legible; decide/cancel/error sounds have distinct handlers; notebook writes play a separate sound. Event dedup prevents repeated notices for already-recorded history. This is static feedback code, not a measured feel/accessibility claim.

yairpg.takeaway: Make speaker changes and saved-note receipts visible. A refusal sound should differ from a successful promise receipt.

A12.summary: Shown: reset code also handles equipment downgrade, consumables, bottle contents, scene clear state and minigame-related registers. The checkout exposes inventory, shops, combat, transformations, cutscenes, audio and effects as additional subsystems in the inventory. Only reset-boundary interactions were inspected; their full catalogs and mechanics remain unread.

yairpg.takeaway: Treat a container, its contents and learned capability as separate retention owners; source-qualified worlds decide which survives.
